implementation_notes: Crates are the module boundary and the compiler enforces them. Within a crate, `pub(crate)` and private modules shrink the surface; `pub(super)` scopes visibility to a subtree. Reach for a separate crate when the boundary is a real change seam.
pitfalls: Everything `pub` so the binary crate can reach it
Splitting a crate so small that cross-crate generics dominate compile time
